text:
The previous run failed on parsing only: the evaluator would not accept `{WB}`-style placeholders. The netlist below keeps the 5-transistor OTA but writes every device size as a number. Values were picked by hand calculation and have not been simulated. The weakest margins are DC gain at the ss/125 °C corner and the 1.98 V power limit.

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* NMOS tail mirror: 10 uA reference -> about 65 uA tail
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2u   L=1u
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=13u  L=1u
* NMOS input pair, wide so it runs near weak inversion (high gm/Id)
M1   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=20u  L=0.5u
M2   vout  vinn  tail vss nfet W=20u  L=0.5u
* PMOS current-mirror load
M3   x     x     vdd  vdd pfet W=8u   L=1u
M4   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=8u   L=1u
.ends dut
```

```json
{
  "topology": "5T OTA (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, NMOS tail mirror)",
  "parameters": {
    "MB": {"W": "2u",  "L": "1u"},
    "MT": {"W": "13u", "L": "1u"},
    "M1": {"W": "20u", "L": "0.5u"},
    "M2": {"W": "20u", "L": "0.5u"},
    "M3": {"W": "8u",  "L": "1u"},
    "M4": {"W": "8u",  "L": "1u"}
  },
  "rationale": {
    "parse_fix": "All W/L are numeric literals; the {WB} placeholders caused the parse error.",
    "currents": "Ibias 10 uA, tail about 65 uA, total about 75 uA. Power is about 149 uW at 1.98 V, under the 190 uW limit.",
    "gm_ugbw": "About 32 uA per side at gm/Id of 15-18 gives gm of about 500-580 uS. GBW = gm/(2*pi*2pF), about 40-46 MHz, above the 29 MHz requirement.",
    "gain": "Gain is about (gm/Id)/(lambda_n+lambda_p). Using L=0.5u for the inputs and L=1u for the loads gives roughly 36-40 dB.",
    "slew": "Slew is about 65 uA / 2 pF, roughly 32 V/us, above the 13 V/us requirement.",
    "phase_margin": "The mirror pole is about gm3/(2*pi*Cx), a few hundred MHz, so phase margin should be about 75-80 degrees with a single dominant output pole.",
    "cmrr_psrr": "Using L=1u for the tail gives high tail output resistance for CMRR. The mirror load gives good low-frequency PSRR.",
    "noise": "The wide input pair and L=1u PMOS loads keep flicker and thermal noise well below 770 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz.",
    "polarity": "vinp sits on the diode side (x), so raising vinp raises vout. vinp is the non-inverting input."
  }
}
```

If gain falls short in simulation, change the input pair to L=0.8u and W=30u, and the loads to L=1.5u and W=12u. That trade costs a little bandwidth, which the current margin can absorb.
